correctness.rationale: For every m>=2, full linking x=0 forces value 0 and Lagrange pi*=-e1 uniquely; fixing x1=t, the remaining weighted cube coordinates span precisely [-S(w),S(w)], giving D(w)=min(1,S/|w1|) (or 1 at w1=0). Linf bound follows |w1|>=1-delta and S<=(m-1)delta, attained by equal errors. L2 envelope uses Cauchy and maximization at epsilon1=rho^2, attained at equal remaining errors; saturation first occurs at rho=1/sqrt(m), delta=1/m. Under scale c/m, T_m/m -> E|G|=sqrt(2/pi), and CLT for T_m plus negligible G1 gives Phi(tau*mu/sqrt(1-2/pi)) for critical scaling. I independently solved 225 rational low-dimensional hyperplane-sliced cube LP instances via vertices and edges, matching closed D exactly. The rigorous infinite/m asymptotic proof uses interval geometry, SLLN, and CLT, not sampling.
